stem_book: A solid sphere and a hollow sphere of the same mass and of same radius are rolled (without slipping, from rest, from the same height) on an inclined plane. Let the time taken to reach the bottom by the solid sphere and the hollow sphere be t₁ and t₂, respectively, then (a) t₁ < t₂ (b) t₁ = 2t₂ (c) t₁ > t₂ (d) t₁ = t₂
reason: added the implied 'without slipping, from rest, same height'; printed in 'Strong Box 2.pdf' page 1 (page 11 = Strong Box 1 + 2 counted together)
work: a = g sinθ/(1 + k²/R²): solid 5g sinθ/7 > hollow 3g sinθ/5 ⇒ t₁ < t₂
